audience: marketers who send email and SMS campaigns with Sarbacane

useCases.title: Check how a campaign performed
useCases.text: The AI reads a campaign's statistics per send: delivered, opens, openers, clicks, clickers, unsubscribers, devices and operating systems.

useCases.title: Check your remaining credits
useCases.text: The AI reads the remaining credits per type, such as email campaigns and SMS, with expiry date and subscription type.

useCases.title: Look at contact lists and their fields
useCases.text: The AI lists contact lists, the custom fields of a list and its contacts, filtered by email, phone, search text or modification date.

useCases.title: Review bounces, unsubscribers and complaints
useCases.text: The AI lists blacklists and the entries of one by kind: bounces, unsubscribers or complaints. It helps you clean a list.

useCases.title: Add or update contacts, or record an unsubscribe
useCases.text: The AI adds a contact with email, phone and custom field values, or updates one when the same email and phone pair already exists. It can also record an unsubscribed contact.

useCases.title: Prepare a draft email campaign
useCases.text: The AI creates a draft campaign, sets its HTML content or imports a template, and attaches a contact list. It is never sent from here.
